description: This Java source file defines the RitaServices class which provides a set of static methods to manage credit card transactions via the RiTA API, including authorization, capture, void, refund, and credit refund functionalities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with payment gateways, handles credit card information, and logs activities.

classes.name: RitaServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling credit card transactions through the RiTA API, including authorization, capture, void, and refund operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization by sending a transaction request to the RiTA API, handling different result scenarios, and returning a map with the operation result and details.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures funds for an authorized transaction by sending a completion request to RiTA API and returning the capture result details.

methods.name: ccVoidRelease
methods.description: Void or release a pre-authorized transaction depending on the context, supporting refunds and releases.

methods.name: ccVoidRefund
methods.description: Performs a refund by voiding or releasing a previous authorization via RiTA API.

methods.name: ccCreditRefund
methods.description: Processes a credit refund related to a previous transaction.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Decides whether to void or refund a transaction based on order terminal state, dispatching to the appropriate method.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Populates the RitaApi instance with credit card details and billing address extracted from the context, or throws exception if credit card info is missing.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a RitaApi instance with the given properties and optional payment type configuration.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Builds property set for RiTA API configuration from the provided context and entity properties, for payment gateway communication.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats a monetary amount from context with proper decimal scaling and rounding for transaction processing.
